description.value: A large, well-serviced BC Parks campground sitting on the shores of Moberly Lake near Chetwynd, offering easy highway access and a calm lakeside setting good for swimming and fishing.

address.value: Moberly Lake Provincial Campground Rd, Moberly Lake, BC V0C 1X0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active BC Parks campground at Moberly Lake — the official BC Parks page loaded successfully and is consistent with the OSM record. OSM tags confirm capacity (109), a sanitary dump station, no internet access, and a fee. The website navigation includes a 'Book camping' link indicating reservations are handled through the BC Parks system, but the fetched page content was largely navigation boilerplate with no park-specific amenity details, so most optional amenities remain unknown.
concerns: The OSM contact email (sandstormnorth@gmail.com) belongs to the private operator Sandstorm North Contracting, not BC Parks — cyclists contacting this address may reach the contractor rather than the parks authority.
The fetched website content was almost entirely navigation boilerplate; no park-specific amenity details (toilets, water, showers, etc.) were captured, leaving most optional amenities unverifiable.
No address or phone number is present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campground with 109 sites confirmed by the official provincial parks website. A legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists in Northern BC.
enrichment_extras.notes: Sanitary dump station confirmed via OSM tag (sanitary_dump_station=yes). No internet access confirmed via OSM tag (internet_access=no).

wow_evidence: easy highway access and a calm lakeside setting good for swimming and fishing
